# Off-GPU inventory

**GPU 100% target: every site below ticked off, nothing off the GPU.**

Generated by `node scripts/off-gpu-scan.mjs --doc` (`npm run offgpu`); do not edit by hand. The checklist at the end is regenerated from the scan, so a site leaves it when it moves to the GPU.
No percentage blocks a push or a deploy; the honest score is printed and the target is 100%. What each category means is at the top of the script.

**881/5338 on GPU (16% honest, counting 677 class-write and timer/observer sites; target 100%), 4457 off: frame path 2717, during use 1732, no caller found 8; 198 setup sites left out of the count and listed; 2046 tagged run-once/rare allocations (// alloc-rare: reason) also left out, listed with their reasons; per-frame view (event-only sites set aside): 881/3606 on GPU (24%), 1732 event-only sites listed apart (timer or rest pass 492, stored callback 320, event handler 294, promise 265, observer 172, store or registry listener 135, event or timer 21, a method of this name is called from timer or rest pass 21, motion handler 6, a method of this name is called from store or registry listener 3, a method of this name is called from stored callback 2, a method of this name is called from event handler 1)**.
